title: Product Update - August 2026
summary: August product update: the Dover CRM, customizable application forms with knockout questions, interview activity reporting, and new startup experts.
body_markdown:
In August, we launched a CRM to manage candidates across every role in one place, made job applications more customizable with knockout questions, and gave you better visibility into your team’s interview activity.


## Marketplace


Dover’s Marketplace gives you flexible access to experienced recruiters and startup experts without the cost of a full-time hire. Browse experts, schedule intro calls, and bring on support when you need it.


### Meet Bill, a startup recruiter


Meet Bill, a senior recruiter with 17+ years of experience building and scaling recruiting functions at high-growth companies. Before joining Dover’s marketplace, Bill worked at **Roblox** (Series D), **PagerDuty** (Series A to C), **Verkada** (Series C), and **Cribl** (Series C).


Since joining Dover, Bill has filled many founding, senior technical, and GTM roles for his startups with an average **cost-per-hire** of **$7,550** .


#### [Meet Startup Experts](https://app.dover.com/marketplace/experts?utm_source=product_newsletter&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=aug26)


Interested in joining the marketplace?[Become an Expert](https://www.dover.com/become-an-expert?utm_source=product_newsletter&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=aug26)


## Applicant Tracking System


Updates to the Dover ATS this month, from a new CRM to more control over your application form and interview reporting.


### Dover CRM


Managing candidates across multiple roles just got a lot easier.


The new CRM brings every candidate, across every role, into one place. Now you can search, filter, and email candidates without jumping between jobs.


#### [Try CRM](https://app.dover.com/crm?utm_source=product_newsletter&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=aug26)


### Customize your application form


Every role has different requirements, and your application should reflect that.


Now you can reorder questions, add multi-select answers, and use knockout questions to automatically screen out unqualified candidates.


Whether you’re screening for work authorization, location, availability, or other must-have skills, use knockout questions to save time screening. You can even delay when applicants get their knockout rejection emails.


#### [Customize Application Form](https://app.dover.com/job-posting?utm_source=product_newsletter&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=aug26)


### See your team’s interview activity


Get a clear view of all interviews booked through Dover Scheduling, including how many interviews your team is conducting and how many hours they’re spending interviewing candidates.


Filter by recruiter or job, and switch between list and calendar views to see interview activity at a glance.


#### [View Interview Activity](https://app.dover.com/home?utm_source=product_newsletter&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=aug26)


Check out our[Marketplace](https://app.dover.com/marketplace/experts?utm_source=product_newsletter&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=aug26) to find startup experts who can help your company grow.
